_note: SYNTHETIC — not a real sxp_activity_criteria row. Invented activity, supplier and city. Numbers are internally consistent (counts reconcile against the denominator, rates against their bars and crit_* flags) but the activity does not exist. Replace with a real exported row when you have one.
_scenario: All three Excellence bars missed at once: rating 4.38 against 4.6, quality defects 3.1% and pickup problems 3.2% against a 2.0% bar. Entry and Trust & Safety both pass, so the failure is purely about on-trip quality — the one case where 'keep working on it' in the banner is actually the right advice. Marrakesh is not a crowded city, so the bars are the global minimums.
_note_details: NOT from the export. `trend` is a month-by-month series per metric — sxp_activity_criteria holds only the window aggregate, so there is no source for this. `disruptions` uses the defect-cards shape (see js/defect-cards.js) and its copy is lifted from the design (672:64888, 672:65527). Note `Duration not as advertised` is NOT one of the 9 ticked SXP quality tags, so a real build would not count it toward this rate.

defects.name: Activity not as advertised

defects.name: Duration not as advertised
defects.description: The actual duration of the activity differed from what was advertised.
recommendations: State the real start and end times, including transfers, in the activity duration
Flag any seasonal variation in the Important Information section

defects.description: The guide did not speak the language originally booked for.
recommendations: Confirm which languages each guide can deliver and keep the option list in sync
Remove languages you cannot staff reliably rather than risk a mismatch

defects.name: Unclear meeting point location
defects.description: The description of meeting point for the activity was not clear, or wrong.
recommendations: Verify your meeting point address is findable via a map app and add a meeting point photo in the Supplier Portal
Include landmarks or directions from the nearest transport stop in the Important Information section

defects.name: Driver/guide were late or did not show up
